Innoruuk ("Inny") is the God of Hate. He spawns on the second floor of the Plane of Hate. Plane of Hate over went a revamp with the Velious expansion. Innoruuk increased in level to 70. His old loot table was moved to mini bosses, and now has a new loot table of racial only items.
